verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's Marketing API is documented as a general-purpose API for campaigns, contacts, and account data (mailchimp-docs-1, -15, -16), and webhooks can push campaign/subscription events (mailchimp-docs-19), which could feed a warehouse. However, the evidence pack never cites a specific Reports/campaign-performance or Automation/Flow-performance endpoint, only click/open tracking as a UI feature (mailchimp-docs-21, -22) and Analytics AI as a dashboard feature (mailchimp-docs-25), not an API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a Reports API endpoint for campaign metrics, an equivalent endpoint for Automation/Flow performance data, and any independent confirmation of pulling these metrics into a warehouse.
